title: Accounts Administrator
description:
A proactive and commercially astute Accounts Administrator is needed to join a highly successful fast-paced business at their office on the outskirts of Exeter, close to the M5, to support the Finance Department.

Accounts Administrator - The Role:
- Running daily financial reports and reconciling daily sales reports, using Sage.
- Reconciling sales ledger statements monthly
- Maintaining strong customer and supplier relationships
- Credit control via email and phone and processing payments
- Maintain strong customer & supplier relationships
- Assisting purchase ledger with processing supplier invoices
- Processing interbranch stock transfers
- Perform general administrative tasks such as managing phone calls, emails, and correspondence
- Supporting the wider office team where needed

Accounts Administrator - The Person:

The successful candidate will be an experienced Accounts Administrator with experience of sales ledger and reconciliations. An effective communicator, you will possess an approachable personality and a confident, positive attitude, credit control experience is beneficial. Knowledge of Sage would be advantageous but not essential, full training will be given.

Salary: £30,000 - £32,000pa depending on experience/qualifications + benefits.

Hours: Monday - Friday, full time, 8:30am - 5:30pm, 30 min lunch break

Location: Office based with parking, Exeter outskirts

This is an urgent requirement with interviews to take place asap, so please don't delay in submitting your CV, we will be in touch promptly to discuss the role and employer. For an informal discussion or further information please contact Jo at Isca Recruitment.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Finance Assistant to join the finance team of a large and highly successful business at their Head Office in Plymouth. This role will see you take responsibility for several cost centres - ensuring all expenditure is accurately recorded and reported in a timely manner.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong organisational skills, great attention to detail, and a passion for financial accuracy to join a well-established organisation with a supportive and collaborative working culture.

Key Responsibilities
- Take ownership of a selection of cost centres and balance sheet codes
- Post and evidence monthly accruals, prepayments and other journals as required
- Analyse costs versus budgets and communicate key variances to the Finance Manager team
- Process company expenses and credit card expenditure
- Code expenditure invoices via the data capture system, ensuring payment deadlines are met
- Conduct aged creditor reviews and supplier statement reconciliations
- Support budgeting and reforecasting activities
- Play a key role in meeting month-end and year-end deadlines
- Undertake ad-hoc finance tasks as required

Skills & Requirements
- Financial qualification (AAT or equivalent) preferred
- Previous experience within a similar finance or accounts role
- Excellent communication and analytical skills
- Strong organisational abilities and attention to detail
- Confident IT user with intermediate to advanced Excel skills
- Ability to work 5 days a week in office

Benefits
- Pension scheme
- Long service awards
- Employee discount
- Cycle to work scheme

If you're a motivated finance professional looking for your next step within a thriving business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Executive
description:

Location: Plymouth

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk (Temp)
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk (Temp)
Exeter, Devon
£29,000 per annum
Temporary, Full-time

Our client, a well-established organisation, is seeking an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk to join their finance team on a temporary basis.

As the Purchase Ledger Clerk, you'll take ownership of a varied transactional finance workload, covering purchase ledger, accounts, reconciliations and general finance administration. You'll liaise with suppliers and internal teams to resolve queries, maintain accurate records and ensure payments are processed efficiently.

This is a great opportunity for an organised and detail-focused finance professional looking for a hands-on role within a supportive team.

The responsibilities:
- Process and maintain purchase ledger transactions
- Check, code and process invoices and credit notes
- Reconcile supplier and financial accounts
- Manage supplier queries and payment discrepancies
- Process payments, banking and electronic transactions
- Support sales invoicing and account administration
- Prepare financial reports, reconciliations and supporting schedules
- Provide wider finance administration and reporting support

The candidate:
- AAT qualified, studying towards, or QBE
- Previous purchase ledger or transactional finance experience
- Good understanding of reconciliations and accounting processes
- Strong IT and Excel skills with excellent attention to detail
- Organised, reliable and confident communicator

If you would like to know more about this Purchase Ledger Clerk opportunity, please get in touch with Andrew Perring, here at Lloyd Barnes Recruitment.
